text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I visit the gym to find Biwa Hayahide,
Winning
Ticket, and Narita Taishin all
there.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Professor Hayahideeee! You
gotta help
meee!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's the matter, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I tried reading the training books you
brought
over, but they're all gibberish to
me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Says here, um, ki... kinetic strength is
needed for acceleration? And
apparently, I have to do
kinetic training
or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's all that mean? Is it some kind of
spell?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not a spell—it's theory. I suppose I
should
elucidate the text for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Think of kinetic muscular strength
as an
explosion—the ability to explode
with power in a
single moment.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now how does one foster such power?
One must
train their fast-twitch muscles.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fast-twitch muscles generally refer to
external or "outer" muscles. Training
them can lead to
enhanced explosive
power.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And how does one train their fast-twitch
muscles? Through kinetic training.
Strength training is a
prime example of
this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That concludes my explanation. I believe
I was
logical and to the point, but did
you comprehend
it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, I'm so LOST! My head's spinning
like
crazy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, it'd be quicker if I gave you a clear

demonstration...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. I know just the thing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: See that barbell over there, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? That heavy-looking thing?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the one. It weighs
approximately 200
kilograms.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Most wouldn't be able to lift that
without solid
muscle strength. However...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Given my daily weight training sessions
and
following the book's logic, I should
be able to lift
it with ease.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because, as I've previously explained,
logic is
absolute.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! Wow, that's some
impressive stuff!
Show me, show me!
Pleeeaaase!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Watch closely and behold the

effectiveness of logic-based training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I shall gradually lower my hips
from my
starting position.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, watch... You see how my thighs
and calves
form a perfect ninety-degree
angle?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As long as I... maintain this for... five
seconds!
Then!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: One... two... three!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh! Theoretically speaking... failure
is
impossible!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... Wheeze... See? Perfectly executed! The logic was flawless!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! That was amazing! Your logic
power is
awesooome!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give that theory thingy a shot!
I'll train
enough to lift a 100-kilogram
barbell!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it pleases me that you have come to
understand the importance of theory.
Let's
continue to support each other in
our endeavors.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Theory? Logic? Wasn't that just all
muscle?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gnaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Urk... I disappoint myself!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, looks like your logicy-ness didn't
work
out...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No! Failure is theoretically impossible!
The logic is
flawless!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I shall lift this barbell at all costs!
The
theory must
be demonstrated in full!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Uh...
I'm pretty sure this isn't about logic
and
more about pure muscle...
